name: get_fact
description: Return the current resolved fact for (tenant_id, subject, predicate): value, status, winning_event_id, policy_version, resolution_reason, validity window. Tenant-scoped; no free-form SQL. Use explain_fact for the full provenance. tenant_id is the requested data scope (authorization handled by the Gateway governance layer).

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose data this operation is scoped to (requested data scope). The Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it.

subject.description: The subject/entity key the fact is about.
